targets.name: Oak-leaf drawer fitting
targets.concealment: The bronze knob and oak-leaf surround blend into the same-tone carved drawer front.

targets.name: Brass drawer bird
targets.concealment: The dull metal bird is nestled in a branch-shaped handle against similarly colored timber grain.

targets.name: Silver shelf hare
targets.concealment: The small silver hare stands between filigree metalwork, glass facets and hanging cloth in the dark shelf corner.

targets.name: Gold spool
targets.concealment: The small gold spool is partly behind the machine and blends with nearby gold engraving and yellow cloth edges.

targets.name: Sewing-machine hare inlay
targets.concealment: The silver-gold hare is a small inlay amid similar floral engraving on the dark machine body.

targets.name: Treadle butterfly
targets.concealment: The bronze butterfly is embedded within dark scrolling treadle ironwork, crossed by surrounding frame lines.

targets.name: Basket dragonfly brooch
targets.concealment: The woven-looking golden brooch follows the basket braid colors and curved wicker rods.

targets.name: Pink perfume atomizer
targets.concealment: Its glass facets, narrow neck and muted pink body are tucked between metallic ornaments and thread colors.

targets.name: Hanging filigree medallion
targets.concealment: The small openwork medallion is suspended among matching gold strings, bells and drooping willow leaves.

targets.name: Lavender flower brooch
targets.concealment: The small flower clasp blends into pale lace and lavender cloth on the dress form.

targets.name: Gold embroidery scissors
targets.concealment: The thin gold blades align with embroidered stems and lace borders, while loop handles lie on patterned cloth.

targets.name: Purple pincushion
targets.concealment: The round purple pincushion is large and displayed openly.

targets.name: Silver thimble
targets.concealment: The thimble is clearly separated on the front edge of the table.

targets.name: Cat beneath the table
targets.concealment: The curled cat has a complete outline against the rug.

targets.name: Moonflower embroidery hoop
targets.concealment: The large embroidery hoop is a clear visual anchor.

review.notes: Fifteen actual targets selected from naturally dense sewing environment: eleven embedded reliefs, fittings and intermingled tools, four easy anchors. Exact visible contours traced and Shapely-valid. Actual iPhone tuning pending. Every target inspected in source-outline contexts. Bird/hare figures and both winged fittings retraced using640px affine source ROIs; full atomizer bulb and hose included, both scissor handle openings excluded.
